title: Signal Editor
text: Display, create, edit, and switch interchangeable scenarios, {Sample time} sets Time interval between samples; {To create and edit scenarios, open Signal Editor user interface} sets the option to open Signal Editor, {File name} sets the data set file, {Active scenario}, {Use properties from} sets the signal property source, {Active signal} sets the signal to configure Signal, {Apply signal properties to all scenarios} sets the option to apply specified signal properties to active, {Apply signal properties to all signals} sets the option to apply signal properties to all, {Output a bus signal} sets the configure signal as bus, {Select bus object} sets the bus object Bus, {Mode} sets the bus object mode, {Unit} sets the physical unit, {Interpolate data} sets the linearly interpolate data, {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the detect zero-crossings and {Form output after final data value by} sets the block output after the last time hit for which data is available Setting. Values come from the instance.
